Frequently Asked Questions

Questions before getting started?

Do you take insurance?

We accept most major insurance plans. Our team will assist in verifying your benefits before getting started. Check out our list of accepted insurance plans HERE.

Do I need a referral to start therapy?

No. You can schedule directly with our team - no referral required.

Do you offer online appointments?

Yes. We provide secure online appointment services for our clients.

What if I’ve tried therapy before and it didn’t help?

Many clients come to us after previous therapy experiences. Our structured, measurement-based approach helps make progress more visible and allows us to adjust care if something isn’t working.
